notes.title: Added multilingual subtitle support&controller support
notes.content:
Fixed multiple bugs
Added multilingual subtitle support (English, Japanese, Traditional Chinese)
Added controller support (Xbox prioritized)

Older versions need to be uninstalled to delete residual files
Re-download the new version to open it

The location of the remnants of the old version is here
C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\LocalLow\liulihuatang\Salvation Immortale

notes.title: [Game Recommendation] Light Yuri VN x Bullet Hell STG: DreamlessGirl
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41044605/a4db08ec91f7b665b045b399e505ccd1772c486d.jpg[/img]

Dear Players,

The new game published by LoveStoryProject, DreamlessGirl, a unique blend of "bullet-hell shooting" and "visual novel," has officially launched on the Steam platform. This game is a visual novel featuring a female protagonist and yuri elements, so we recommend it to you.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2242840/_DreamlessGirl/

We hope you enjoy it!
